identity.name: Shuichi "Ponta" Murakami
identity.summary: Japanese jazz drummer and session player, a sideman for Sadao Watanabe, Yōsuke Yamashita, Kazumi Watanabe and Masayoshi Takanaka in the 1970s and 1980s and then for J-pop stars for decades; led the trio Ponta Box.

contribution.description: The leading Japanese studio drummer of his time: the sideman of choice in Tokyo jazz and fusion in the 1970s and 1980s, then the drummer on J-pop records for decades.

beatbreaker.songs_short_because: 15-b sweep (2026-10-22): Japanese session drummer with thousands of credits; I could not confirm titled tracks by him beyond the two albums, whose track lists I could not check.
